facts.business: Petronet LNG Limited imports, stores, and regasifies LNG at its Dahej and Kochi terminals in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Dahej terminal name plate capacity expansion from 17.5 MMTPA to 22.5 MMTPA
Truck loading bays doubled from four to eight at Dahej

guidance_or_targets.statement: India's natural gas demand expected to grow steadily with policy support and infrastructure expansion
Natural gas to serve as important bridging fuel in India's energy transition and net-zero ambitions

key_risks: Foreign exchange risks, particularly USD-INR fluctuations
Geopolitical uncertainties impacting LNG supply chains
Delay in development of gas infrastructure and pipeline connectivity
Regulatory uncertainties, including delay in GST implementation
Competition from renewable energy and alternate fuels
Wider spread between long-term contract prices and spot LNG prices impacting demand dynamics
facts.related_party_note: Investments in joint ventures and subsidiaries including Adani Petronet (Dahej) Port Limited, India LNG Transport Company (No.4) Private Limited, Petronet LNG Foundation, Petronet Energy Limited, Petronet LNG Singapore Pte. Ltd., MC2 Foundation. Loans to India LNG Transport Co. (No 3) Ltd. Pledged shares with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation toward loans taken by ILT3 and ILT4.
